x.Name: Materiality
x.Description: Tangible, measurable reality where physical actions occur.

y.Name: Interconnectivity
y.Description: The relationships and connections between entities and planes.
y.LogicalNotation: ∀e1, e2 ∈ Entities, ∃r ∈ Relations : Connects(r, e1, e2)

z.Name: Abstraction
z.Description: Non-material, conceptual structures underlying physical reality.

Passage.Description: Linear progression of time, where events unfold sequentially.
Passage.LogicalNotation: ∀e1, e2 ∈ Events, ∃t1, t2 ∈ Time : (t1 < t2) → Precedes(e1, e2)

Periodicity.Description: Cyclical recurrence of events and feedback loops across different realities.
Periodicity.LogicalNotation: ∀e ∈ Events, ∃P ∈ ℝ⁺ : ∀t ∈ Time, Occurs(e, t) ↔ Occurs(e, t + P)

Presence.Description: The immediate 'now', capturing current experience across all planes.

ExistentialSuperposition.Definition: Multiple states and possibilities coexist across planes until acted upon by an observer or interaction.
ExistentialSuperposition.Implications: Reality is shaped by potential states, collapsing into determined paths based on action and observation.
ExistentialSuperposition.LogicalNotation: ∀s ∈ States, ∃Ψ : (Ψ = ∑ αᵢ|sᵢ⟩) ∧ (∃o ∈ Observers : Observe(o, Ψ) → Collapse(Ψ, s))

CausalLoopDynamics.Definition: Time is both linear and cyclical, with events in higher dimensions influencing both past and future.
CausalLoopDynamics.Implications: Actions in the present can echo backward or forward, creating feedback loops across realities.
CausalLoopDynamics.LogicalNotation: ∀e ∈ Events, ∃t1, t2 ∈ Time : (t1 < t2) ∧ Influences(e(t2), e(t1)) ∧ Influences(e(t1), e(t2))

Meta-OntologicalDuality.Definition: Each plane reflects both material and immaterial realities, constantly interacting to define truth and being.
Meta-OntologicalDuality.Implications: Existence is not confined to physical reality, but also shaped by abstract, intellectual, and spiritual dimensions.
Meta-OntologicalDuality.LogicalNotation: ∀p ∈ Planes, ∃m ∈ Material, i ∈ Immaterial : Reflects(p, m) ∧ Reflects(p, i) ∧ Interacts(m, i)

InterdimensionalInfluence.Definition: Planes of reality are interconnected, and changes in one dimension influence others.
InterdimensionalInfluence.Implications: The Body interacts with the Mind, the Spirit with the Heart, and these interactions shape overall existence.
InterdimensionalInfluence.LogicalNotation: ∀p1, p2 ∈ Planes, ∃i ∈ Influences : Connects(i, p1, p2) ∧ (Change(p1) → Change(p2))

SymphonicTemporalCoherence.Definition: All events must maintain consistency across space and time, respecting coherence and progression across dimensions.
SymphonicTemporalCoherence.Implications: Each action, decision, and interaction fits into a larger temporal and spatial framework, ensuring narrative consistency.
SymphonicTemporalCoherence.LogicalNotation: ∀e1, e2 ∈ Events, ∀d ∈ Dimensions : Consistent(e1, e2, d) ∧ (Precedes(e1, e2) → ProgressivelyCoherent(e1, e2))

TemporalCoherence (Ψ).Description: Ensures narrative consistency across all planes.
TemporalCoherence (Ψ).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E ∈ Events(W) : Ψ(E) ↔ ∃ξ(CoherentNarrative(ξ, W) ∧ ∀e ∈ E : Participates(e, ξ))

CausalInfluence (Γ).Description: Links causes and effects across dimensions.
CausalInfluence (Γ).LogicalNotation: Γ(E1(t1) → E2(t2), W) → ∃t1, t2 (t1 < t2 ∧ E1(t1) ∧ E2(t2) ∧ CausalLink(E1, E2, W))
CausalInfluence (Γ).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E1, E2 ∈ Events(W) : Γ(E1, E2) ↔ ∃λ(CausalNexus(λ, W) ∧ Connects(λ, E1, E2))

Presence (𝓟).Description: Captures the immediacy of events across planes.
Presence (𝓟).LogicalNotation: 𝓟(E, W) → ∃t (E(t) ∧ ∀t' (|t - t'| < ε → Current(t', W)))
Presence (𝓟).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E ∈ Events(W) : 𝓟(E) ↔ ∃ν(ImmediateNow(ν, W) ∧ Manifests(E, ν))

TemporalOrdering (𝓕).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E1, E2 ∈ Events(W) : 𝓕(E1, E2) ↔ ∃τ(TemporalSequence(τ, W) ∧ Precedes(E1, E2, τ))

Periodicity (𝓒).LogicalNotation: 𝓒(E, P, W) → ∀t ∃n∈ℤ (E(t) ↔ E(t + nP) ∧ W)
Periodicity (𝓒).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E ∈ Events(W), ∃P ∈ ℝ⁺ : 𝓒(E, P) ↔ ∃ρ(CyclicPattern(ρ, W) ∧ Repeats(E, ρ, P))

QuantumSuperposition (Σ).Description: Allows multiple potential states to coexist until collapse.
QuantumSuperposition (Σ).LogicalNotation: Σ(E1, E2, ..., En, W) → ∃t ∀i (Probability(Ei(t), W) = pi ∧ ∑pi = 1)
QuantumSuperposition (Σ).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀S ⊆ States(W) : Σ(S) ↔ ∃φ(QuantumWavefunction(φ, W) ∧ ∀s ∈ S : Superposed(s, φ))

ObserverDependentReality (Ω).Description: Collapses potential states based on observation.
ObserverDependentReality (Ω).LogicalNotation: Ω(E, O, W) → ∃t (E(t, W) ↔ Observe(O, E, t, W))
ObserverDependentReality (Ω).TranscendentalForm: ∀W ∈ Worlds, ∀E ∈ Events(W), ∀O ∈ Observers : Ω(E, O) ↔ ∃µ(ConsciousPerception(µ, O) ∧ Actualizes(µ, E, W))

ShadowOrder.Definition: The realm of potential forms and unrealized possibilities.
ShadowOrder.Geometry: A negative curvature reflecting unrealized paths and echoes of latent potential.
ShadowOrder.Core Mechanism: Reaction to external stimuli without conscious control.

QuantumOrder.Definition: The probabilistic field where multiple potentialities coexist before collapsing into reality.
QuantumOrder.Geometry: Branching hyperbolic curves representing superposition of multiple states.
QuantumOrder.Core Mechanism: Collapse of potential into a single actualized state.
QuantumOrder.Temporal Placement: Between Shadow and Body, N-0.5 plane, bridging unconscious reaction and conscious choice.
QuantumOrder.LogicalNotation: ∀s ∈ States : QuantumOrder(s) ↔ (∃ψ(Wavefunction(ψ) ∧ Superposed(s, ψ)) ∧ ∃o(Observer(o) ∧ (Observe(o, s) → Collapse(s))))

MaterialOrder (Body).Definition: The physical, tangible realm where quantum potentials are realized.
MaterialOrder (Body).Geometry: Euclidean-like space embedded in hyperbolic structure, reflecting concrete reality.
MaterialOrder (Body).Temporal Placement: N plane, the realm of direct interaction with the material world.

ExistentialOrder.Definition: The domain of the self, where the individual becomes aware of its existence and responsibility.
ExistentialOrder.Geometry: Curved spaces representing existential awareness and self-reflection.
ExistentialOrder.Temporal Placement: Between Body and Heart, N+0.5 plane.
